Re: Claim C-1282 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents George Booker in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot on 10-9-23. Our client was
stopped and waiting for a parking space when your insured's vehicle backed into the driver's side of our client's car. The impact
was significant enough to deploy the airbag warning system and leave both vehicles with visible structural damage, and the
police report prepared at the scene reflects that your insured acknowledged the contact.
As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a lumbar back strain. Within hours, our client experienced stiffness, muscle
spasms, and pain that radiated into the hip. Medical providers have prescribed physical therapy, prescription anti-inflammatory
medication, and a period of restricted activity. Our client has missed time from work and continues to struggle with ordinary
tasks such as lifting, driving for extended periods, and sleeping through the night.
Liability is clear. Your insured was operating the vehicle in reverse and failed to keep a proper lookout before moving. We have
enclosed the medical records, billing statements, wage documentation, photographs of the damage, and the police report.
Our client is prepared to resolve this matter without litigation. We demand payment of $174,000.00 within thirty days of the date
of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response by that deadline, we will file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Michelle James, accident reconstructionist
Sincerely,
Jennifer Black
Montoya & Solis Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
